mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.0% indicates a deteriorating labor market and weak economic growth, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% and year-over-year CPI inflation above 2.5% signals a monetary tightening cycle that reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of housing market expansion (HOUST > 1500 thousand units), rising housing starts signal robust consumer demand and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1500 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production level above 100 (index 2017=100) indicates robust economic activity and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 100 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate below 7.5% indicates a strengthening labor market and accelerating economic growth, triggering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 7.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST > 1500) and industrial production (INDPRO > 100) signals a broad-based economic recovery, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST > 1500 and INDPRO > 100 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A strong quarterly GDP growth rate (above 3.0% annualized) indicates robust economic expansion and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 3.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
